<includeonly><infobox type="Character">
    <title source="name"/>
    <image source="image">
        <caption source="imagecaption" />
    </image>
    <group>
        <data source="type">
            <label>Type:</label>
            <format>{{#switch:{{{type|}}}
| NPC    = [[:Category:Characters|NPC]]
| Chest  = [[:Category:Chests|Chest]]
| Boss   = [[Enemies|Boss]]
| Elite  = [[Enemies|Elite]]
| Enemy  = [[Enemies|Enemy]]
| {{{type|}}}
}}</format>
        </data>
        <data source="faction"><label>Faction:</label></data>
        <data source="factionChange"><label>Faction Changes on Kill:</label></data>
        <data source="class"><label>Class:</label></data>
        <data>
            <label>Map</label>
            <default>{{#if:{{{zones|}}}|{{#if:{{{name|}}}|[https://erenshor.compendiums.org/map?sel={{#ifeq:{{{type|}}}|NPC|npc|enemy}}:{{urlencode:{{{name|}}}}} View on the interactive map]}}}}</default>
        </data>
        <data source="zones"><label>Zones:</label></data>
        <data source="coordinates"><label>Coordinates:</label></data>
        <data source="location"><label>Location:</label></data>
        <data source="respawn"><label>Base Respawn:</label></data>
        <data source="spawnchance"><label>Spawn Chance:</label></data>
        <data source="spawntype"><label>Spawn Type:</label><default>{{{spawnType|}}}</default></data>
        <data source="level"><label>Base Level:</label></data>
        <data source="experience"><label>Base Experience:</label></data>
        <data source="guaranteeddrops"><label>Guaranteed {{#if:{{{guaranteedrolls|}}}|{{{guaranteedrolls}}}|One}} Of:</label></data>
        <data source="droprates"><label>Overall Drop Rates:</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Abilities</header>
        <data source="spells"><label>Spells:</label></data>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>Base Stats</header>
        <group layout="horizontal">
            <data source="health"><label>Health:</label></data>
        </group>
        <group layout="horizontal">
            <data source="ac"><label>AC:</label></data>
        </group>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>Base Resists</header>
        <group layout="horizontal">
            <data source="magic"><label>Magic:</label></data>
            <data source="poison"><label>Poison:</label></data>
        </group>
        <group layout="horizontal">
            <data source="elemental"><label>Elemental:</label></data>
            <data source="void"><label>Void:</label></data>
        </group>
    </group>
</infobox>{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACENUMBER}} | 0 | {{#switch: {{{type|}}}
| Boss                      = [[Category:Enemies]][[Category:Bosses]]
| Elite                     = [[Category:Enemies]][[Category:Elites]]
| NPC                       = [[Category:Characters]]
| Chest                     = [[Category:Chests]]
| [[Simulated Players|Sim]] =
| #default                  = [[Category:Enemies]]
}} }}</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
